note: GAPS.md corrections: "Upon Silence" is George Benjamin's (Faber; Nimbus NI 5505), not Berio's; it is added under Benjamin as the string version (mezzo-soprano, 2 violas, 3 cellos, 2 basses per IRCAM), and the existing viol entry 107577 could be retitled "(version for mezzo-soprano and five viols)". "Michael Finnis" is Edmund Finnis (Devotions, Solem Quartet, Delphian 2023). Gibbs and Fitzenhagen are already in the catalogue (106377, 104936). Barcarolle: the Naxos disc (Fine Arts Quartet, Cristina Ortiz) and the Dabrin disc (Mozart Piano Quartet) are played by ensembles with no harmonium player, so the recordings behind entry 103325 (harmonium scoring) are probably of this quartet version; the owner may want to review that entry's floor. Simpson's Piano Trio is on Hyperion CDA66737 (x08 skipped it wrongly). Perger's Op. 12 is recorded by the Concordia String Trio (Centaur, 2017), which settles the Zellner/Perger mix-up; its IMSLP page was a t16 candidate. No recording found, kept on a published edition plus documented professional performances: Silvestrov Quartet No. 3 (Belaieff; Kronos), Larcher Quartet No. 4 (Schott; Belcea) and the piano-trio version of A Padmore Cycle (premiere Wiener Konzerthaus 2017; the printed trio score was not seen, only the tenor-and-piano edition). Kagel Piano Trio No. 3: year not found, left blank. Lavista Quartets 7 and 8 skipped (performed in 2022, but no recording or edition found); Rimsky-Korsakov G major skipped (nothing recorded or performed found). Pages at Schott, Stretta, Delphian and Gramophone would not open (403/429); the few facts taken from their search-result snippets (Finnis year and catalogue number, Larcher publisher) are marked in the floor field.
